title: verbascum × nothum subsp. subphlomoides
intro: Verbascum × nothum subsp. subphlomoides, commonly known as Mullein, is a hybrid plant species within the Scrophulariaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat a variety of health issues, including respiratory problems, skin irritations, and inflammation, due to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Mullein include flavonoids, saponins, and mucilages, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Mullein include soothing coughs, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing, making it a popular natural remedy for various health issues.
